workspace-bound-agent-grant-01.graded_text: Each agent connection is bound to one firm workspace chosen at consent and approved by that firm's Admin, and a consultant who works for several firms makes a separate connection for each.

votes.e: C/project/docs/agent-access.md:7 "An agent connection is a delegation by one person to one client installation, approved by an Admin of exactly one firm workspace. Its grant is permanently bound to that workspace. A consultant working for three firms needs three separately approved connections and separate credentials"; :35 "The consultant signs in and explicitly chooses one firm from currently verified memberships."; :37 "A current Admin in the selected firm ... approves a subset or denies."

workspace-bound-agent-grant-02.graded_text: The server checks on every call that the target belongs to the connection's bound workspace and that the consultant's membership and role are still live, so removal from a firm cuts off an existing connection.

votes.e: C/project/docs/agent-access.md:48-52 "For every request: ... 2. Resolve the immutable grant ... 3. Read current role and resource permissions rather than treating issuance-time role claims as lasting authority."; :66-67 "Resolve by `(grant.workspace_id, id)`"; :79 "Membership removal, identity disablement, or workspace closure invalidates dependent grants."; :81 "If authoritative status cannot be established, fail closed."

workspace-bound-agent-grant-03.graded_text: The design offers no connection whose scope spans more than one firm.
